bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
name="$names"
printf 'GAYBBS_CONTAINER=%s\n' "$name"
docker exec "$name" sh -c 'test -r /run/secrets/bot_token && command -v node >/dev/null'
printf 'BOT_SECRET_READABLE_BY_EXISTING_CONTAINER=YES\n'
docker inspect -f 'CONTAINER_RUNNING={{.State.Running}} READ_ONLY={{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}}' "$name"
printf 'BOT_EXEC_PREFLIGHT=PASS\n'
